data.title: PC İletişim Reports 75,500-Share Buy-Back on Nov. 13
data.description:

PC İletişim ve Medya Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.Ş. is identified as both the company conducting and the company subject to the share buy-back. The release provides no further information on its products or market focus.

data.title: Marmara Capital Fund Sells GOLTS Shares, Holding Falls Below 5%
data.description:
Goltas Goller Bolgesi Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. ( (TR:GOLTS) ) has provided an announcement.

On 11 November 2026, Marmara Capital Portföy Yönetimi A.Ş. reported that Marmara Capital Portföy Hisse Senedi (TL) Fonu sold 42,688 GOLTS shares at an average price of 240.35834, within a 238.50–241.90 range. The fund’s holding fell from 5.34% to 4.99% of GOLTS’s free-float shares.

Across three Marmara Capital funds, including the fund that sold the shares, combined ownership declined from 5.72% to 5.37% of GOLTS’s free-float shares. The transaction prompted a fund-founder notification under the applicable disclosure framework, while the release did not describe any operational or strategic changes for GOLTS.

data.title: OBI Pharma Signs ADC Platform Collaboration and License Agreement With Novartis
data.description:
OBI Pharma, Inc. ( (TW:4174) ) has provided an announcement.

OBI Pharma, which has an antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) platform for developing next-generation ADC drugs, signed a collaboration and license agreement with Novartis Pharma AG to expand the platform’s use worldwide.

The agreement includes a $30 million upfront payment, potential milestone payments tied to development, regulatory approval and commercial goals, royalties on net sales of licensed products, and a total potential value exceeding $2 billion. OBI will conduct agreed research, while revenue recognition will follow applicable accounting standards and the company may not receive all milestone payments.

data.description:

data.title: Azio AI Holdings Stockholders Approve Key Corporate Proposals
data.description:
Azio AI Holdings ( (AZIO) ) has shared an update.

Azio AI Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, reconvened its annual meeting on November 13, 2026, after it had been adjourned from November 2 because of a lack of quorum. Holders of 54.2% of outstanding common stock were present virtually or represented by proxy, establishing a quorum.

Stockholders approved the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, which became effective immediately, and approved the election of Larry G. Paige II, accounting-firm ratification, 2025 executive compensation on an advisory basis, a discretionary reverse-split amendment ranging from 1-for-15 to 1-for-30, and authorizing meeting adjournment when needed for further proxy solicitation. The Conversion Proposal remained unresolved because the Company’s initial listing application required by Nasdaq had not yet been approved.

data.title: 3D Systems Completes Debt Exchange and Issues New Shares
data.description:
An announcement from 3D Systems ( (DDD) ) is now available.

On November 12, 2026, 3D Systems issued $85 million of 3.30% convertible senior unsecured notes due 2031 to holders in exchange for all outstanding 2030 Notes. The company also paid $20 million in cash and issued 13,471,138 common shares as additional consideration.

The 2031 Notes accrue interest semiannually and mature on April 1, 2031, subject to earlier repurchase, redemption or conversion under their terms. Following the exchange, the 2030 Notes indenture was satisfied and discharged, and related guarantees and collateral liens were released; 3D Systems also issued 1,464,206 shares to J. Wood Capital Advisors for transaction-related services.

data.title: byNordic Acquisition Corp. Extends Business Combination Deadline
data.description:
byNordic Acquisition Corp. Class A ( (BYNO) ) just unveiled an update.

On November 9, 2026, BYNO deposited $8,850.20 into its trust account, extending the period to complete its initial business combination from November 12 to December 12, 2026. data.title: Accuray Completes Major Financing Transaction with TCW
data.description:
Accuray ( (ARAY) ) has issued an announcement.

On November 13, 2026, Accuray announced it had completed its financing transaction with TCW, its primary lender and largest shareholder. TCW exchanged $40 million of term-loan principal and its $15 million cash investment for Series A convertible preferred stock, while certain financial covenants were waived through December 31, 2027 and a delayed-draw loan of up to $5 million remained available subject to conditions.

Accuray also completed a 1-for-40 reverse stock split effective November 9, 2026, following stockholder approval on October 6, and increased its authorized common-stock shares before the split. The transaction reduced board size from eight to seven, gave TCW the right to appoint two directors, and automatically canceled warrants covering approximately 27.6 million pre-split common shares.

data.title: Otello Reports Share Buyback Transactions
data.description:
The latest update is out from Otello Corporation ASA ( (GB:0FI5) ).

Pareto Securities AS purchased 175,814 shares on behalf of Otello Corporation ASA from 9 to 13 November 2026, at an average price of NOK 17.76 and a total value of NOK 3,122,804. Since the program began, 1,552,212 shares have been acquired for NOK 27,623,416 at an average price of NOK 17.80; Otello currently holds 6,739,216 treasury shares, while the program allows purchases of up to 2,192,046 shares at no more than NOK 25 per share.
